target: Choose an independent take-profit and stop-loss distance at entry from current market features. Positions remain open until a barrier executes; cutoff valuation marks remaining positions. The earlier fixed action grid supplies 25 feasible TP/SL pairs per side.
features: Use 34 market features plus setup age already pinned to the eligible SMA decisions. Includes trailing returns, volatility, moving-average levels, volume, BTC/ETH context, RSI, and Bollinger Band features. Use separate long and short models. No news input in the bracket-selection model.
training: For every early candidate replay all 25 actions in base and stress. The target is average net dollars across the two modes for a desk-risk-sized standalone position, including fees and funding. Positions open at the fold end use marked equity, with no additional exit fee. Center outcomes across actions on each candidate and fit to relative after-cost value. Exclude rows with unresolved funding or pricing for any action. Weight equal days and equal setups per day.
model: Compare a regularized multi-output ridge and shallow multi-output extremely randomized trees. Choose each action by predicted maximum net dollars. Select the adaptive model family on the mean of the worse base/stress daily net P&L across two expanding pre-February validation replays, with shared desk controls and constant entry scores.
comparison: Freeze January-end fit and compare against the earlier fixed bracket and a side-specific unconditional action from the same training returns on the existing August 22–November 22 historical replay. Refit ridge and neural entry scores using the adaptive exits. Full-period entry inputs reuse market and publication ages; News Intelligence remains evaluated on its saved history only. Reuse version 17 directional desk controls and candle simulation, one position per symbol. Historical comparisons are retrospective.
